readerCopy.summary: An institution rebuilds its authority after opening the records and changing who can exercise power without review.
readerCopy.body: An institution rebuilds its authority after opening the records and changing who can exercise power without review. Contracts, reporting lines, budgets, and consequences are rewritten so the reform survives beyond the leader who announced it. Saturn gives the change a durable structure, while Pluto reaches the deeper control that made the original failure possible. Under the trine, discipline and transformation reinforce each other without settling for a symbolic resignation. Trust can begin to return because the new limit applies to the office, not only to the person who was caught.
